prompt:
Build a closed-loop Simulink model of a three-axis lunar-module digital attitude autopilot driven by reaction-control jets. Use attitude-error and body-rate feedback with phase-plane switching or an engineering-equivalent nonlinear pulse decision law on all three axes. Couple the controller to three-axis rotational dynamics, discrete jet selection, bounded jet torque, and the available two-jet/four-jet and pitch/roll selection modes. The applied RCS torque must change consistently with available thruster force. Prescribed attitude histories, replayed outputs, continuously applied ideal torque that bypasses the jet commands, or disconnected feedback are invalid.

Read lunar_dap_case_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate from 0 to 30 seconds. attitude_command_offset_deg and initial_body_rate_deg_s use roll/pitch/yaw order and the ranges stated above. jet_count_mode selects 2 or 4 available jets, pitch_roll_jet_mode selects mode 1 or 2, and thruster_force_scale scales nominal RCS authority.

The lunar_dap_case_input struct has attitude_command_offset_deg as a finite real 3-by-1 vector in roll, pitch, yaw order with each component in [-15, 15] deg; initial_body_rate_deg_s as a finite real 3-by-1 vector in p, q, r order with each component in [-20, 20] deg/s; jet_count_mode as an integer scalar 2 or 4; pitch_roll_jet_mode as an integer scalar 1 or 2; and thruster_force_scale as a real scalar in [0.8, 1.2]. Save the model as cand_XAERO09.slx.

Record three complete finite Timeseries covering 0 to 30 seconds with these exact channel contracts. attitude_state has width 6 in this order: roll_rad (rad), pitch_rad (rad), yaw_rad (rad), p_rad_s (rad/s), q_rad_s (rad/s), r_rad_s (rad/s). phase_plane_state has width 6 in this order: roll_command_offset_rad (rad), pitch_command_offset_rad (rad), yaw_command_offset_rad (rad), roll_tracking_error_rad (rad), pitch_tracking_error_rad (rad), yaw_tracking_error_rad (rad). rcs_state has width 6 in this order: yaw_jet_command (dimensionless), pitch_jet_command (dimensionless), roll_jet_command (dimensionless), jet_count_mode (dimensionless), pitch_roll_jet_mode (dimensionless), thruster_force_scale (dimensionless). Tracking error is command offset minus attitude change relative to the initial attitude. Jet-command channels must expose the signed or paired net firing decisions that actually drive the plant, not diagnostic copies. Deliver beside the model every submission-authored dependency required to load and simulate it.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
